business_scope.primary_industry_name: Production and Global Distribution of Vertical Micro-Dramas

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital) arts. 20-22, 23-33, 59-67; Real Decreto 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil); Ley 14/2013 (Ley de Emprendedores) establishing the CIRCE electronic incorporation system.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (corporate name certification); Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office (inscription); Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) for NIF; Notaría for the public incorporation deed.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura de Constitución (public deed of incorporation) executed before a Spanish notary, submitted via the DUE/CIRCE electronic dossier where available, and subsequently filed for registration in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 minimum share capital, fully subscribed and fully paid up in cash at the time of deed execution, evidenced by a blocked deposit certificate issued by a Spanish credit institution; no escrow account is permitted because full payment must precede the notarial act (arts. 4 and 62 LSC). Non-cash contributions require an independent expert valuation report under arts. 67-73 LSC.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) that the subscribed shares of the Company be allotted in full to the founding members, the paid-up capital having been certified as deposited in accordance with article 4 of the Consolidated Text of the Capital Companies Act; (2) that the registered office be adopted at the address stated in the deed and that all statutory notifications be served there; (3) that [NAME] be appointed Sole Administrator with full powers; (4) that the Sole Administrator open all corporate bank accounts, obtain definitive corporate tax identification (NIF), and file for registration before the Mercantile Registry; (5) that all incorporation and pre-incorporation expenses be ratified and assumed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social (Negative Corporate Name Certificate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central — Sede Electrónica (CIRCE/TOMEGA portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the official application form (hoja de solicitud 022-C2) with at least one and no more than three proposed corporate names in order of preference. The Central Registry verifies that no prior identical or confusingly similar name exists and issues the negative name certificate valid for three months, within which the chosen name must appear verbatim in the deed.
required_dossiers: Official name application form 022-C2
Proposed corporate denomination(s)
Identity details of each founding member (name, ID/passport, nationality)
Payment receipt of the official certificate fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is rejected for identity or similarity, immediately refile selecting the next alternative name on the same application; submit a written reconsideration to the Registro Mercantil Central within fifteen days; or obtain a fresh certificate under a newly constructed denomination before the three-month validity expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Deposit of Share Capital and Blocked Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution supervised by Banco de España, selected by the incorporators
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of the future entity (ES_SL), each founding member subscribing in cash a minimum of EUR 1 with aggregate capital reaching at least EUR 3,000. Instruct the bank to issue a blocking certificate (certificado de desembolso) that confirms the balance and states that funds are reserved exclusively for the incorporation deed; the certificate must be dated within not more than two or three months before the notarial execution.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate
Draft bylaws (Estatutos Sociales)
Passport or DNI/NIE of each founding member and proposed administrator
Beneficial ownership declaration under Law 10/2010
Statement of source of funds (standard AML form)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the credit entity requires a provisional tax identification code to open the account, obtain the provisional NIF from AEAT before deposit; if the first bank refuses or delays, transfer the amount to an alternative Spanish bank and obtain a fresh blocking certificate for the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary of the incorporators' choice in the province of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary in person or through a lawful attorney with the name certificate, bank blocking certificate, fully drafted bylaws, and capital allocation schedule. The notary verifies legal capacity, the lawful nature of the corporate object (CNAE 5911 — audiovisual production and digital distribution), the effective payment of capital, and the identity of shareholders. The notary issues a first copy for the Mercantile Registry and a second copy for tax filings and municipal procedures.
required_dossiers: Certificado de denominación social
Certificado bancario de desembolso/bloqueo
Estatutos sociales signed by all founding members
Passport/DNI/NIE of all incorporators
Power of attorney when acting by representative (with apostille if foreign)
Modelo 600 (ITPAJD) declaration prepared for subsequent settlement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For discrepancies or formal defects, execute a corrective supplementary deed (acta complementaria) before the same notary; if the deposit certificate is stale, obtain a new or renewed bank certificate and re-execute the deed; if the object clause is qualified by the notary, amend the bylaws before signature.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Provisional NIF, Censal Declaration (Modelo 036), and ITPAJD Settlement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) — provincial delegation of the registered office; Consejería de Hacienda of the Autonomous Community for ITPAJD
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 business days after deed execution, (i) file Modelo 036 to request the provisional NIF and declare commencement of activity (with CNAE 5911 and IAE epigraph 962.3), and (ii) present Modelo 600 to the autonomous treasury for settlement of the capital-transfer stamp tax (Modalidad de Operaciones Societarias at 1% flat); retain the paid receipt for the Mercantile Registry filing.
required_dossiers: First copy of the execution deed
Modelo 036 signed by the legal representative
Modelo 600 (ITPAJD liquidación)
DNI/NIE and NIE/Pasaporte of the sole administrator
Lease contract or address title for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any errors via Modelo 036 rectification before attendant sanctions; late ITPAJD is admitted within the voluntary late-filing window with recargo rates of 10-20%, beyond which a surcharge procedure applies; if the provisional NIF is refused, resolve the identify discrepancies and refile with the AEAT office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil de la provincia del domicilio social
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the first copy of the deed together with proof of ITPAJD payment to the provincial Mercantile Registrar for qualification. The registrar verifies legality and may issue a defect note within 15 working days; once qualified, inscription is effected and the registrar issues a certified copy of the company sheet (hoja registral), which constitutes conclusive evidence of the company's existence and is required for definitive NIF, banking operations, and app-store developer accounts.
required_dossiers: Primera copia de la escritura de constitución
Certificación/pago del Modelo 600 (ITPAJD)
Provisional NIF certificate
Sealed Modelo 036
Corporate books for subsequent legalization
Tariffs evidence (electronic payment of registry fees)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a nota de calificación, remedy the defects within the statutory 60-day period by executing rectifying deeds or submitting additional documents; appeal the registrar's decision to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within one month of notification; re-file immediately once the defect is cleared, keeping the original filing date priority where tariffs permit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive NIF, Legalization of Corporate Books, and Commencement of Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: AEAT for definitive NIF; Registro Mercantil for book legalization; Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social for employment registration; local Ayuntamiento for premises declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Under six months from the provisional NIF, submit the certified hoja registral to AEAT to convert the NIF to definitive status, without which invoicing and banking are paralyzed. Simultaneously, deposit for legalization the share register, minutes book, and accounting books with the Mercantile Registrar; register the administrator and employees with the Social Security system (TA.6/RED) within 7 days of hiring; and file the municipal declaración responsable for the office premises before opening.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the Mercantile Registry sheet
Provisional NIF certificate
Libro registro de socios, libro de actas, libros de contabilidad
Lease contract and fire-safety certificate
Plan de prevención de riesgos laborales
TA.6 employee registration forms
Municipal declaración responsable for activity commencement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If definitive NIF conversion is delayed by AEAT, reactivate the file with the hoja registral and observe the six-month deadline; where the provisional NIF has expired, request an ex-officio regularization and accept the administrative penalty path; if book legalization is refused, correct the formal defects and resubmit within the registry's re-entry period; municipal requirements are curable by submission of a corrective sworn declaration unless public-safety risk exists.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Instituto de la Cinematografía y de las Artes Audiovisuales (ICAA) — Ministerio de Cultura y Deporte for voluntary registration as an audiovisual production enterprise; local Ayuntamiento for filming-site permits and office-premises activity clearance; Dirección General de Industria for any incidental manufacturing, not applicable to digital streaming.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for pure digital distribution of vertical micro-dramas; optional 'Registro Administrativo de Empresas Cinematográficas y Audiovisuales' (Orden CUL/2834/2009) is recommended to access state incentives and coproduction benefits; a municipal 'licencia de apertura' or 'declaración responsable' under Law 12/2012 is mandatory for the physical office premises and any studio set used in production.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the relevant Autonomous Community; Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) for cross-autonomy or state-level emissions matters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — Not classified under Annexes I or II of Law 21/2013 on Environmental Impact Assessment; the digital streaming platform and professional offices trigger no full EIA, Environmental Authorization, or Unified Environmental Authorization; only a simplified municipal environmental form is required where the office is within a commercial building.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for software-only operations. Incidental physical sets, if any, must comply with Law 37/2003 (noise) and Law 7/2022 (waste and contaminated land); office waste handling obeys R.D. 1055/2017 (packaging) and R.D. 110/2015 (WEEE); if a self-managed data center is installed in Spain, state emissions monitoring obligations under the EU ETS scheme apply only above 20MW thermal input, and ventilation/REF VOC thresholds under R.D. 100/2011 do not apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification per Código Técnico de la Edificación DB-SI and R.D. 513/2017 (means of evacuation, extinguishers, emergency lighting); structural load inspection where studio support systems exceed 300 kg/m²; occupational health and safety clearance under Law 31/1995 and R.D. 39/1997, including a mandatory risk-assessment plan, appointment of an external prevention service (SPA), health-surveillance arrangements, and an emergency plan for premises with 50 or more employees; municipal opening declaration confirming workforce sanitary installations and accessibility.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) and official portal at https://www.agenciatributaria.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Resident Spanish entities (SL) obtain NIF upon formation; non-resident foreign entities register with AEAT for TIN if maintaining permanent establishment or Spanish-source income, following incorporation and tax residency declaration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Limited hybrid mismatch elections under EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive; no US-style check-the-box for Spanish entities, which are subject to entity-level taxation with territorial scope.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 300,000 EUR annual taxable turnover in Spain
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing system for VAT-registered taxpayers; real-time fiscal reporting and digital stamping via AEAT platforms for clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT on exports of goods outside the EU upon proof of export and destination; offshore services subject to specific VAT Directive rules and place of supply determination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT with penalties up to 100% of evaded tax plus interest; criminal prosecution for fraudulent claims under Spanish Penal Code.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of the financial year; ordinarily by 30 April for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late legalisation may impair evidentiary value and trigger administrative penalties where applicable; no automatic strike-off applies solely for late book legalisation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval and deposit of annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual accounts must generally be approved within six months after year-end and deposited within one month after approval; ordinarily by 31 July for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines generally range from EUR 1,200 to EUR 60,000, with higher limits for larger companies; the Registry may close the company sheet after one year of non-filing. Spain has no automatic administrative strike-off solely for this default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the first 25 calendar days of the sixth month following the end of the tax period; ordinarily 1 to 25 July for a calendar-year taxpayer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts statutory surcharges and interest; failure to file may trigger fixed or percentage-based penalties, generally increasing where tax is unpaid or concealment is alleged.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner declaration included with annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Relevant Provincial Mercantile Registry and the Central Registry of Beneficial Ownership where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed with the annual accounts; beneficial-owner changes must be reflected without undue delay and through the applicable electronic update process
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or omitted beneficial-owner information may prevent or delay registration and may expose the company and responsible persons to administrative, commercial, and anti-money-laundering sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT summary return, Modelo 390, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Spanish State Tax Administration Agency (Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally filed during the first 30 calendar days of January for the preceding calendar year; exemptions apply to qualifying taxpayers and filing profiles
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted filing may result in fixed or percentage-based tax penalties; the obligation does not apply where a statutory exemption is available.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit is generally mandatory when, for two consecutive financial years, the company exceeds at least two of: EUR 2.85 million in total assets, EUR 5.7 million in annual net turnover, and 50 average employees. Additional mandatory-audit cases apply to certain regulated, listed, consolidated, or publicly funded entities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish Generally Accepted Accounting Principles under the Spanish General Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad). IFRS is mandatory for specified consolidated groups and may apply to other regulated reporting contexts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must identify and maintain current information on individuals ultimately owning or controlling it. Beneficial-owner information is confirmed or updated through the annual accounts filing and must be updated when ownership or control changes. Share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the beneficial-owner information where they alter ultimate control.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors and statutory appointment records
Legalised accounting books and supporting accounting documentation

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 300-1,200 per year, approximately USD 325-1,300; Spain does not generally require a separate registered agent, and pricing depends on address, mail handling, and corporate secretarial services.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Approximately EUR 1,500-6,000, or USD 1,625-6,500, for a small Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada subject to mandatory audit; fees vary by turnover, transaction volume, group reporting, and reporting complexity.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% Spanish Corporate Income Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) for limited companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Newly incorporated SL: 15% reduced rate for the first two tax periods in which an economic activity is carried on (Art. 29.1 LIS). Audiovisual production and distribution activities may benefit from the Spanish film/audiovisual tax credit under Art. 36.3 LIS, including international micro-drama production costs incurred in Spain. R&D and technological innovation credits also remain available. The Spanish regime currently permits indefinite carryforward of negative tax bases, but is subject to turnover-based annual caps; the model applies a conservative five-year staging horizon.
